name: Understand Anything
hook: Egonex-AI's 85.9k-star plugin (7.2k forks) turns any codebase, knowledge base, or docs into an interactive knowledge graph you can explore, search, and query — 'Graphs that teach > graphs that impress.' Updated Oct 10. Supports fuzzy + semantic search, domain/flow views, and diff-impact analysis before commits. Install takes one marketplace command.

name: Claude Haiku 5.5 Now Default
hook: Claude Code v2.1.293 (Oct 7) made claude-haiku-5-5 the default Haiku on the Anthropic API. It brings a 1M-context window at $0.10/$0.50 per million tokens (input/output) — half the context cost of prior Haiku with 10x the window. Prompts over 100K tokens are $0.50/$2.50/M. Drops into any existing workflow automatically.

name: Marketing Skills for Claude Code
hook: 54.2k-star collection (8k forks) giving AI agents CRO, copywriting, SEO, A/B testing, lifecycle email, cold email, paid ads, referrals, and pricing skills — 30+ skills total. Updated Oct 8. The foundation `product-marketing` skill is a prerequisite that the others build on; install the full set or cherry-pick individual skills with `--skill`.

name: Scientific Agent Skills
hook: 48.4k-star library (4.3k forks) of 177 reusable skills that turn Claude Code into an AI scientist — genomics, single-cell RNA-seq, CRISPR, cheminformatics, molecular docking, clinical trials, pharmacokinetics, neuroscience, materials science, and 100+ scientific databases including PubChem, UniProt, and ClinicalTrials.gov. Updated Oct 5.

name: wshobson/agents — Multi-Harness Plugin Marketplace
hook: 40.4k-star (4.3k forks) plugin marketplace covering Claude Code, Codex, Cursor, OpenCode, Copilot, Google Antigravity, and Pi. Hosts 94 plugins, 202 agents, 184 skills, and 105 commands — including Python dev (3 agents, 16 skills), JS/TS, code review, and security scanning. Updated Oct 5. Single install adds all plugins for your chosen host.

name: Awesome Agent Skills
hook: 35.5k-star (3.8k forks) curated index of 1,000+ agent skills from official dev teams and the community — covering Cloudflare, Vercel, Netlify, Terraform, Azure, Stripe, Supabase, ClickHouse, Expo, Flutter, Trail of Bits security, TestMu testing, and more. Updated Oct 11 today. Serves as the canonical cross-harness skill discovery list.

name: NanoClaw
hook: 30.9k-star (12.8k forks) open-source AI assistant that runs Claude SDK agents in isolated Linux containers and connects them to WhatsApp, Telegram, Slack, Discord, and Gmail. One-script install handles Node/pnpm/Docker setup. Positioned as a minimal, auditable alternative to OpenClaw's 500K LOC monolith — channels and providers added as installable skills rather than baked in. Updated Oct 11.
install: git clone https://github.com/nanocoai/nanoclaw.git && cd nanoclaw && bash nanoclaw.sh

name: Distilly
hook: 25.5k-star (2.2k forks) skill (formerly Colleague Skill) that distills how a specific person thinks and communicates into a reusable Agent Skill — sourcing from Lark, DingTalk, Slack, WeChat exports, X posts, PDFs, and emails. Three profile families: colleague (work persona), relationship (communication style), and celebrity (public figures). Updated Sep 22. Works across Claude Code, Hermes, OpenClaw, Codex, and others.

name: notebooklm-py
hook: 19.7k-star (2.6k forks) unofficial Python API, CLI, and agent skill for Google Gemini Notebook (formerly NotebookLM). Adds Claude Code integration for creating notebooks, running web/Drive research with auto-import, generating audio overviews, videos, slide decks, quizzes, and mind maps, plus bulk export to MP3/MP4/PDF/PPTX. Also exposes an MCP server with 40 tools. Updated Oct 11 today.

name: Claudian — Claude Code Inside Obsidian
hook: 15.6k-star (1.1k forks) Obsidian plugin that runs Claude Code, Codex, Grok Build, or OpenCode as an AI collaborator directly inside your notes vault — your vault becomes the agent's working directory. Features sidebar chat, inline word-level diff editing, Zen Mode, Skills and slash commands, @mentions of vault files, MCP server connections, and session tabs. Install via Obsidian Community Plugins browser.
install: Install via Obsidian → Settings → Community Plugins → Browse → 'Claudian'

name: brag — Launch Video Generator
hook: 15.1k-star (1.1k forks) agent skill that turns any project you just built into a short launch video with music and motion in one command — uses Hyperframes for rendering. Writes a `brag-output/` folder with a plan, composition brief, share copy, and `brag.mp4`. Includes `/brag-slim` for lighter Opus 5.5 runs. Optional voiceover via Kokoro. Updated Oct 9.

name: Skill Seekers
hook: 15.1k-star Python CLI and MCP server that converts 18 source types — docs sites, GitHub repos, PDFs, Word, EPUB, Jupyter notebooks, OpenAPI specs, Confluence, Notion, Slack exports, and more — into packaged Claude agent skills. Exports to 22 targets including Claude, Gemini, OpenAI, LangChain, Pinecone, and 19 coding agents. MCP server exposes 40 tools. Conflict detection prevents overlapping skill coverage.

name: memU — Personal Memory Wiki
hook: 14.5k-star (1.1k forks) personal memory layer stored as a shared LLM wiki that works across sessions, agents, and devices. Automatically extracts reusable Markdown skills from session history and retrieves relevant memory before answering. SQLite or Postgres+pgvector backends; hosted MemU Cloud available. Core memory logic is ~500 lines. Supports Codex, Claude Code, Cursor, OpenClaw, Hermes, and more. Updated Oct 9.

name: Awesome Claude Code Toolkit
hook: The most comprehensive curated toolkit for Claude Code: 135 agents, 35 skills, 42 commands, 176+ plugins, 20 hooks, 15 rules, 7 templates, 14 MCP configs, 26 companion apps, and 52 ecosystem entries in one repo. Regularly updated reference for practitioners who want a single source of truth rather than searching multiple registries.
